purpose: Connect a verified effective repair candidate to the existing authoritative axm.ship-state.v1 fault lifecycle without inferring restored state.
reuses_existing: v0.7 repair verification and fault-clearance candidate

authority_policy.command_required: mission commander plus primary procedure role authorization required
authority_policy.note: The current crew-role registry does not yet contain an explicit fault-clearance authority verb, so this candidate policy is intentionally not presented as existing canon.

reconciliation_rule: Every state path mutated by the source failure effect, plus the source-system mode, must be supplied with an exact current-value precondition, an evidence-backed verified value, and non-empty evidence IDs. No inverse-damage or baseline-restoration arithmetic is allowed.
atomic_effects: reconcile only approved evidence-covered state paths
remove only the target failure id from the target system active_fault_ids
preserve or retarget other command-required recalls
append verified_clearance to the existing hash-chained fault ledger
forbidden: mark a system nominal while another active fault remains
accept a tampered repair attempt, candidate, or procedure definition
